In detail

The valley running inland behind the port — Rivarolo, Certosa, Bolzaneto, Pontedecimo — and the ground under the new Ponte San Giorgio. Certosa and Pontedecimo are named priority areas in the Comune's 2026 urban safety plan, and Bolzaneto was part of the April 2026 joint operation across the western districts. Residential and industrial, with nothing that brings visitors here.
